title: calea amellus
intro: Calea amellus, commonly known as "Mexican Damiana," is a flowering plant native to Mexico and Central America. The health benefits of Calea amellus include its ability to reduce stress and anxiety, improve sleep quality, and alleviate symptoms of menopause, including hot flashes and mood swings. The therapeutic actions of Calea amellus are attributed to its sedative and anti-anxiety properties, which are achieved through its ability to modulate the activity of neurotransmitters in the brain. The bioactive constituents of Calea amellus include flavonoids, terpenoids, and iridoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
